Research focus

Cross-disciplinary teams, reproducible science, and clinically grounded impact.

Generative medical imaging

Building high-fidelity synthetic datasets (GANs, diffusion, text-to-image) that address data scarcity and privacy in clinical workflows.

Synthetic endoscopy DeepSynthBody Quality assurance

Trustworthy clinical AI

Designing explainable, auditable decision systems for ECG analysis, GI tract screening, and musculoskeletal health interventions.

Explainability Robustness Regulatory readiness

Real-world deployments

Translating lab breakthroughs into hospital pilots through multi-institutional collaborations and agile research engineering.

Clinical trials Translational AI Cross-disciplinary teams
